claims: Administer IV fluids to maintain adequate volume status.
Administer blood transfusion if hemoglobin < 7 g/dL.
Administer IV potassium if serum potassium < 3.5 mEq/L.
Administer IV calcium if ionized calcium < 0.9 mmol/L.
Assess for signs of infection and consider broad-spectrum antibiotics if indicated.
Administer IV insulin if blood glucose > 180 mg/dL.
Continue mechanical ventilation with settings that maintain adequate oxygenation and ventilation.
Administer IV neostigmine to reverse any residual neuromuscular blockade.
Monitor coagulation status with INR and PT.
